quarters.label: Q1
quarters.theme: Build Momentum: Carry holiday traffic into the new year and keep a strong experiment backlog ready for the spring shopping season.

quarters.label: Q2
quarters.theme: Technical Foundations: Focus on complex builds and audience exploration that will power personalized experiences later in the year.

quarters.label: Q3
quarters.theme: Ramping Up: Make sure control audiences are clean and tracking is solid ahead of the Q4 rush, and test bold variations to find winners.

quarters.label: Q4
quarters.theme: Peak Season: Q4 drives the largest share of annual revenue. Highest-impact personalization campaigns and winning variants should be live before October.
